description: The pie chart titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set" represents the proportion of data sources used in the training set for a study on automatic evaluation of attribution by large language models. The chart is divided into ten slices, each corresponding to a different data source. The largest slice, representing 31.3%, is attributed to "NQ," followed by "SNLI" at 15.4%, and "VITAMINC" at 13.0%. "XSUMHUL" accounts for 1.6%, "SCITAIL" for 1.2%, "PUBHEALTH" for 0.5%, "MULTINLI" for 11.3%, "MULTIFC" for 0.5%, "SCIFACT" for 0.1%, "ENTFA" for 1.8%, "FACTCC" for 2.6%, "ANLI" for 4.6%, and "FEVER" for 16.1%. The chart includes percentage labels for each slice, and the colors of the slices are distinguishable, with "NQ" in blue, "SNLI" in orange, and "VITAMINC" in teal. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest segment at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
